title: Physics Informed Reinforcement Learning with Gibbs Priors for Topology Control in Power Grids
abstract: arXiv:2604.01830v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Topology control for power grid operation is a challenging sequential decision making problem because the action space grows combinatorially with the size of the grid and action evaluation through simulation is computationally expensive. We propose a physics-informed Reinforcement Learning framework that combines semi-Markov control with a Gibbs prior, that encodes the system's physics, over the action space. The decision is only taken when the grid enters a hazardous regime, while a graph neural network surrogate predicts the post action overload risk of feasible topology actions. These predictions are used to construct a physics-informed Gibbs prior that both selects a small state-dependent candidate set and reweights policy logits before action selection. translated_title: 基于吉布斯先验的物理信息强化学习用于电网拓扑控制
translated_abstract: 电网运行的拓扑控制是一个具有挑战性的序贯决策问题，因为动作空间会随着电网规模的增大而呈组合式增长，且通过仿真进行动作评估的计算成本高昂。我们提出了一种物理信息强化学习框架，将半马尔可夫控制与作用于动作空间、编码系统物理特性的吉布斯先验相结合。仅在电网进入危险状态时才做出决策，同时由图神经网络代理模型预测可行的拓扑动作在执行后的过载风险。这些预测被用于构建物理信息的吉布斯先验，该先验既能筛选出一个较小的、依赖于状态的候选动作集，又在动作选择之前对策略logits进行重新加权。通过这种方式，我们的方法降低了探索难度和在线仿真成本，同时保留了学习到的策略的灵活性。我们在三个真实的电网环境中对该方法进行了评估。
tldr: 该论文提出一种将半马尔可夫控制与编码电网物理特性的吉布斯先验相结合的物理信息强化学习框架，利用图神经网络代理预测动作过载风险以缩减候选动作集并重加权策略，从而有效缓解电网拓扑控制中动作空间的组合爆炸与在线仿真成本高昂的难题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a physics-informed reinforcement learning framework that combines semi-Markov control with a Gibbs prior encoding grid physics, using a graph neural network surrogate to predict post-action overload risk, thereby shrinking the candidate action set and reweighting policy logits to overcome the combinatorial action explosion and high simulation costs in power grid topology control.
